annotations.title: Banned-vendor exposure of federal research awards

description: Research Exposure Ledger headline numbers: federal research awards whose 2025-26 papers name a vendor on a banned-vendor list (DoD 1260H Chinese military companies, Section 889 telecom/video, FCC Covered List, UFLPA forced-labor entity list, BIOSECURE biotech companies of concern) as the sequencing, contract-research, drone, camera or network provider they used. Per list: listed vendors and listing dates, papers, awards, FY2025 dollars (broad, narrow-attribution and most-likely-paid cuts), institutions, direct federal purchases; per rule (Section 889 grants ban, American Security Drone Act, BIOSECURE grace period, UFLPA import presumption; FCC Covered List as information only): award counts by status; the in-force / no-grace lead cut (in_force) and the split by award class; top agencies and institutions. Lists are re-pulled from the Federal Register, eCFR, FCC and DHS, and every award is re-scored when one changes. Free.
